mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an accommodative monetary policy environment that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. This mechanism is always active during periods of low interest rates.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in periods of declining FEDFUNDS are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 8.0% indicates a weak labor market, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 8.0%, or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A joint decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals weakening consumer demand, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of HOUST < 710 and RSAFS < 400000 fails to predict negative returns in > 40% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.02 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In a regime of low inflation (CPIAUCSL < 230) and low interest rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%), the Federal Reserve maintains an accommodative stance, supporting equity valuations and producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: low inflation and low interest rates
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC for the regime condition is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in the regime are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 100) and GDP (GDPC1 < 14000) signals a contraction in economic output, reducing corporate profitability and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of INDPRO < 100 and GDPC1 < 14000 fails to predict negative returns in > 40% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.02 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in monthly payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals strengthening labor market conditions, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in periods of rising PAYEMS are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL reading above 230 indicates elevated inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, which increases discount rates and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 230, or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a housing market recovery phase (HOUST > 700), rising housing activity signals improving consumer confidence and economic growth, which supports equity valuations and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST > 700, or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).
